function_v0.doc:
Pulls collateral into custody and updates accounting atomically.

`operator` must be BorrowerOperations or DefaultPool, and `from` must
authorize the exact invocation. This intentionally combines Ebisu's
transfer and accounting steps so accounting cannot be increased without
a real SAC balance increase.
function_v0.name: deposit

function_v0.doc: Sends collateral from custody while preserving both recorded and raw\nSAC balance invariants.
function_v0.name: withdraw

function_v0.doc: Accounts collateral already transferred by the configured DefaultPool.\nA raw-balance solvency check prevents unfunded accounting.
function_v0.name: account_received

function_v0.doc: Moves active collateral to the configured DefaultPool and accounts the\nreceiving pool in the same atomic invocation.
function_v0.name: send_to_default_pool

function_v0.doc: Permissionless maintenance. This extends only this contract's instance\nentry; the XLM SAC maintains its own ledger entries.
function_v0.name: extend_ttl

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Contracts permitted to move ActivePool state for one collateral branch.

These addresses are bound once after all branch contracts have been
deployed. They are immutable in storage version 1.
udt_struct_v0.name: PoolRoles

fields.doc: Passive recipient of the non-Stability-Pool interest share. It may be\na ledger treasury account or a downstream Wasm distribution contract.
fields.name: interest_router

udt_struct_v0.doc: Reconciliation view between protocol accounting and the SAC ledger.
udt_struct_v0.name: CollateralBalance

fields.doc: Unsolicited SAC transfers are reported as surplus and are never silently\nincorporated into borrower collateral accounting.
fields.name: surplus

function_v0.doc: Binds the branch contracts exactly once after they all exist on-chain.\nNo economic entrypoint is usable before this succeeds.
function_v0.name: bind_roles

function_v0.doc: Atomically mirrors the BranchManager's timelocked yield split without\nmaking ActivePool call back into a BranchManager already on the stack.
function_v0.name: set_stability_pool_yield_split

function_v0.doc: Approximate post-change average rate used to quote an upfront fee.\nThe caller must pass a zero upfront fee to avoid circular accounting.
function_v0.name: approximate_average_rate

function_v0.doc: Ebisu-compatible aggregate-interest checkpoint. The Stability Pool\nshare is delivered through the normal ActivePool -> StabilityPool\ncallback used by protocol operations outside StabilityPool.
function_v0.name: mint_agg_interest

function_v0.doc:
Deprecated rolling-upgrade alias for the pre-v5 selector.

Keep this for one release so an older BranchManager can still settle
interest after ActivePool is upgraded. New integrations must use
`mint_agg_interest`.
function_v0.name: mint_pending_interest

function_v0.doc:
Settles a complete batch transition in one ActivePool invocation.

Moving between a batch and individual accounting previously called
this contract twice, which made a one-trove exit exceed Stellar's
testnet CPU budget. The bounded payout list preserves exact manager
fees while aggregate debt and interest are settled only once.
function_v0.name: account_for_batch_change

function_v0.doc:
Soroban-specific no-callback checkpoint for StabilityPool entry and
exit. Calling the normal path from StabilityPool would attempt
StabilityPool -> ActivePool -> StabilityPool contract re-entry.

The exact Stability Pool share is minted before it is returned. The
caller must allocate the returned amount against its pre-mutation
deposit snapshots in the same atomic invocation.
function_v0.name: mint_agg_interest_for_sp

function_v0.doc: Irreversibly freezes interest accrual at the current ledger timestamp.\nBranchManager is responsible for checking the shutdown collateral ratio.
function_v0.name: set_shutdown

udt_struct_v0.doc: Normalized price returned by every Lucent-compatible price feed.
udt_struct_v0.name: PriceData

fields.doc: Quote-asset units per whole base asset, scaled by `decimals()`.
fields.name: price

fields.doc: Ledger timestamp at which this value was last updated.
fields.name: updated_at

udt_struct_v0.doc: A fetch may transition the branch to permanent final-unwind mode. Borrower\nopenings/adjustments must reject a newly detected failure; exits may finish.
udt_struct_v0.name: PriceFetch

udt_union_v0.doc: Asset identifier defined by Stellar Ecosystem Proposal 40.
udt_union_v0.name: Sep40Asset

udt_struct_v0.doc: Raw observation returned by a SEP-40 source.
udt_struct_v0.name: Sep40PriceData

udt_struct_v0.doc: Existing pool debt and accounted collateral, read in one invocation.
udt_struct_v0.name: PoolTotals

udt_struct_v0.doc: One-ledger snapshot of the branch data needed to allocate a redemption.\nKeeping these values in one call avoids repeated Wasm instantiation and\nmakes every value in the registry quote internally consistent.
udt_struct_v0.name: RedemptionBranchState

fields.doc: This invocation committed a new price-feed-failure shutdown.
fields.name: new_shutdown

udt_struct_v0.doc: Branch-local trove record. Trove IDs intentionally match the `u32`\nidentifier required by the Soroban NFT standard used for transferable\nownership.
udt_struct_v0.name: Trove

udt_struct_v0.doc: One atomic trove adjustment. Every field is an unsigned economic amount\nrepresented as a non-negative `i128`; opposing fields cannot both be set.
udt_struct_v0.name: Adjustment

fields.doc: Neighbor with an interest rate greater than or equal to this trove.
fields.name: next_id

fields.doc: Neighbor with an interest rate less than or equal to this trove.
fields.name: previous_id

udt_struct_v0.doc: One bounded management-fee payout settled while a trove moves between\nbatch and individual accounting. A batch switch can involve at most the\nold and new managers, so callers must never supply more than two entries.
udt_struct_v0.name: BatchFeePayout

udt_struct_v0.doc: Shared identity tuple for the trove and policy contracts that must agree\non one branch. Keeping it typed avoids long, order-sensitive address lists\nat deployment verification boundaries.
udt_struct_v0.name: CoreComponents

udt_struct_v0.doc: Immutable risk boundary used by the first single-collateral trove slice.
udt_struct_v0.name: RiskParameters

fields.doc: Additional collateral-ratio buffer for batched troves.
fields.name: batch_collateral_ratio_buffer

fields.doc: Must equal `COLLATERAL_GAS_COMPENSATION_DIVISOR`. It remains in the\nserialized parameter set for ABI compatibility, but is not governable.
fields.name: collateral_gas_comp_divisor

fields.doc: System critical collateral ratio, scaled by `RATE_SCALE`.
fields.name: critical_collateral_ratio

fields.doc: Maximum aggregate active debt in starUSD base units.
fields.name: debt_cap

fields.doc: Minimum non-zero trove debt in starUSD base units.
fields.name: minimum_debt

fields.doc: Minimum interval chosen at batch-manager registration, in seconds.\nIndividual delegates use the owner's interval without this floor.
fields.name: minimum_rate_change_period

fields.doc: Window after opening or a rate change during which an early-change fee applies.
fields.name: rate_change_cooldown

fields.doc: starUSD delivered to the owner, excluding the upfront fee.
fields.name: borrowed_amount

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Immutable component addresses registered for one collateral branch.

This ABI type lives in the shared crate so contracts can call the registry
without linking the registry contract Wasm into their own artifact.
udt_struct_v0.name: Branch
